```{r, load-events}
rmats_event_dir <- "splicing_analysis/rmats"
transcript_filters <- c("transcripts", "tsl_filtered", "biotype_filtered")
id_col <- "event_id"

transcript_filter <- "biotype_filtered" # "transcripts" #
event_type <- "SE"

event_res <- sapply(
  transcript_filters,
  function(transcript_filter) {
    sapply(
      to_analyze, # as_events
      function(event_type) {
        print(sprintf(
          "Loading events for %s, %s",
          transcript_filter,
          event_type
        ))
        event_file <- file.path(
          rmats_event_dir,
          transcript_filter,
          paste0("event_", event_type, ".psi")
        )
        event_dt <- fread(event_file)
        setnames(event_dt, "V1", id_col)
        sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
        # drop all columns not in id_col or rnas_to_use, not all rnas are present in the event files (CREST data), so we need to intersect with the columns that are actually there
        event_dt <- event_dt[, c(id_col, sample_cols), with = FALSE]

        # prepare the alternative/upstream/downstream regions.
        # needs some data wrangling depending on the event type but basically we just parse the SUPPA event id
        # some information only needed for SE and RI and deleted for the other types
        if (event_type == "SE") {
          event_dt[,
            c("event_gene", "seqnames", "e1s2", "e2s3", "strand") := tstrsplit(
              get(id_col),
              ":",
              fixed = TRUE
            )
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("e1", "s2", "e2", "s3") := c(
              tstrsplit(e1s2, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE),
              tstrsplit(e2s3, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
            )
          ]
          all_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = e1, end = s3),
              strand = strand
            )]
          upstream_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(
                start = ifelse(strand == "+", e1, e2) + 1,
                end = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s3) - 1
              ),
              strand = strand
            )]
          downstream_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(
                start = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1) + 1,
                end = ifelse(strand == "+", s3, s2) - 1
              ),
              strand = strand
            )]
          event_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = s2, end = e2),
              strand = strand
            )]
        } else if (event_type == "RI") {
          event_dt[,
            c(
              "event_gene",
              "seqnames",
              "s1",
              "e1s2",
              "e2",
              "strand"
            ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("e1", "s2") := tstrsplit(
              e1s2,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )
          ]
          all_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = s1, end = e2),
              strand = strand
            )]
          upstream_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(
                start = ifelse(strand == "+", s1, s2),
                end = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e2)
              ),
              strand = strand
            )]
          downstream_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(
                start = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s1),
                end = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1)
              ),
              strand = strand
            )]
          event_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = e1 + 1, end = s2 - 1),
              strand = strand
            )]
        } else if (event_type %in% c("AL", "AF")) {
          event_dt[,
            c(
              "event_gene",
              "seqnames",
              "s1/e1s2",
              "e1s3/e2",
              "s2/e1s3",
              "e2s3/e3",
              "strand"
            ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)
          ]
          event_dt[
            ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"),
            start_all := as.integer(`s1/e1s2`)
          ]
          event_dt[
            ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"),
            start_all := tstrsplit(
              `s1/e1s2`,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )[[1]] +
              1
          ]
          event_dt[
            ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"),
            end_all := as.integer(`e2s3/e3`)
          ]
          event_dt[
            ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"),
            end_all := tstrsplit(
              `e2s3/e3`,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )[[2]] -
              1
          ]
          all_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
              strand = strand
            )]
          upstream_gr <- NULL
          downstream_gr <- NULL
          event_gr <- NULL
        } else if (event_type %in% c("A3", "A5")) {
          event_dt[,
            c(
              "event_gene",
              "seqnames",
              "e1s2/e2s3",
              "e1s3",
              "strand"
            ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("e1/e2", "s2/s3") := tstrsplit(
              `e1s2/e2s3`,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("e1", "s3") := tstrsplit(
              e1s3,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )
          ]
          all_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = `e1/e2` + 1, end = s3 - 1),
              strand = strand
            )]
          upstream_gr <- NULL
          downstream_gr <- NULL
          event_gr <- NULL
        } else if (event_type == "MX") {
          event_dt[,
            c(
              "event_gene",
              "seqnames",
              "e1s2",
              "e2s4",
              "e1s3",
              "e3s4",
              "strand"
            ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)
          ]
          event_dt[,
            start_all := tstrsplit(
              e1s2,
              "-",
              fixed = TRUE,
              type.convert = TRUE
            )[[1]] +
              1
          ]
          event_dt[,
            end_all := tstrsplit(e3s4, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)[[
              2
            ]] -
              1
          ]
          all_gr <-
            event_dt[, GRanges(
              seqnames = seqnames,
              ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
              strand = strand
            )]
          upstream_gr <- NULL
          downstream_gr <- NULL
          event_gr <- NULL
        } else {
          stop("unknown event")
        }
        if (event_type %in% to_analyze) {
          # show event_dt without sample_cols
          hits <- findOverlaps(event_gr)

          from <- queryHits(hits)
          to <- subjectHits(hits)

          # keep <- from != to
          # from <- from[keep]
          # to <- to[keep]

          n <- length(event_gr)
          # Build an undirected graph, get components
          g <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(cbind(from, to), directed = FALSE)
          # Ensure isolated vertices are included
          stopifnot(igraph::vcount(g) == length(event_gr))
          # make sure that the graph has the same order as event_gr
          stopifnot(all(igraph::V(g) == unique(from)))
          # extract the components
          comp <- igraph::components(g)
          # add the cluster membership to the event_dt
          event_dt[, event_cluster := comp$membership]
          # get number of NAs per row in the sample columns
          event_dt[, n_na := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = sample_cols]

          # clip PSI to avoid 0/1 issues for logit
          eps <- 1e-4
          psi_clipped_dt <- event_dt[,
            lapply(.SD, function(x) pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)),
            .SDcols = sample_cols
          ]

          # logit transform
          psi_logit_dt <- psi_clipped_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) {
            log(x / (1 - x))
          })]

          # compute variability on logit scale (robust)
          event_dt[, mad_logit := apply(psi_logit_dt, 1, mad, na.rm = TRUE)]
          event_dt[, iqr_logit := apply(psi_logit_dt, 1, IQR, na.rm = TRUE)]

          # keep sd for reference (optional, still on raw scale)
          event_dt[,
            sd := apply(.SD, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
            .SDcols = sample_cols
          ]
          # get the representative of each cluster, which is the one with the lowest number of NAs, highest iqr_logit, then highest mad_logit, in that order
          event_dt[,
            cluster_representative := event_id ==
              .SD[order(n_na, -mad_logit, -iqr_logit)[1], event_id],
            by = event_cluster
          ]
          # note whether on autoposomes or gonosomes
          event_dt[, is_autosome := !seqnames %in% c("chrX", "chrY")]
          event_dt[, transcript_filter := transcript_filter]
          return(list(
            event_dt = event_dt[,
              c(
                "event_id",
                "gene_id",
                "seqnames",
                "strand",
                "Event Type",
                "transcript_filter",
                "event_cluster",
                "cluster_representative",
                "n_na",
                "iqr_logit",
                "mad_logit",
                "sd",
                "is_autosome",
                ..sample_cols
              )
            ],
            # dt with event info
            event_gr = event_gr,
            # gr of alternative region
            upstream_gr = upstream_gr,
            # gr of upstream region
            downstream_gr = downstream_gr,
            # gr of downstream region
            all_gr = all_gr # merged gr
          ))
        }
        list()
      },
      simplify = FALSE
    )
  },
  simplify = FALSE
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, event-filtering}
# make one large GRanges object with all events
# sapply(to_analyze,
#   function(x) {
#     sapply(transcript_filters,
#       function(y) event_res[[y]][[x]]$event_dt[, table(cluster_representative, is_autosome)],
#       simplify = FALSE
#     )
#   },
#   simplify = FALSE
# )

# stack event_dts and gr objects for SE and RI events
event_dt <- data.table()
event_gr <- GRanges()
upstream_gr <- GRanges()
downstream_gr <- GRanges()
all_gr <- GRanges()
for (transcript_filter in transcript_filters) {
  for (this_event in to_analyze) {
    this_dt <- copy(event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_dt)
    this_event_gr <- event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_gr

    # actually append the data to GRanges
    event_gr <- c(event_gr, this_event_gr)
    upstream_gr <- c(
      upstream_gr,
      event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$upstream_gr
    )
    downstream_gr <- c(
      downstream_gr,
      event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$downstream_gr
    )
    all_gr <- c(all_gr, event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$all_gr)
    # actually append the data to data table
    event_dt <- rbind(event_dt, this_dt)
  }
}

rm(event_res)
# adjust ids to be unique indices
event_dt[, ID := seq.int(.N)]
event_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)] # make sure the order is correct
event_dt[,
  transcript_filter := factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters)
] # make sure the order is correct
# event_dt[, table(cluster_representative, is_autosome, transcript_filter, `Event Type`)]
event_dt[
  cluster_representative & is_autosome,
  table(transcript_filter, `Event Type`)
]

# include experimental events manually, to make sure models are built for this:
#  4019, 4020, 460:463, 310:314, 8201:8202, 1658, 1048:1049, 13896:13897)

# double check ids
cols_to_factor <- c("event_id", "gene_id", "seqnames", "strand")
event_dt[, (cols_to_factor) := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = cols_to_factor]
sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
```

```{r, split-event-dt}
# Split wide event_dt → static annotations + long-format PSI (§ structural refactor)
event_annotations_dt <- event_dt[, !..sample_cols, with = FALSE]
psi_long_dt <- melt(
  event_dt[, c("ID", ..sample_cols), with = FALSE],
  id.vars = "ID",
  variable.name = "uuid",
  value.name = "psi",
  variable.factor = FALSE
)
rm(event_dt)
gc()

# Write minimal event coordinate table for Pangolin (event_id parsed by Python)
fwrite(
  unique(event_annotations_dt[, .(event_id, `Event Type`, ID)]),
  "processed_data/pangolin_events.csv"
)
```

Export sequences for MaxEntScan

```{bash, download-genome, eval = FALSE}
wget -q -O data/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz http://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/archive/old_genbank/Eukaryotes/vertebrates_mammals/Homo_sapiens/GRCh38/seqs_for_alignment_pipelines/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz
```

```{r, export-sequences}
library(Biostrings)
genome_fasta <-
  "data/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz"
genome <- readDNAStringSet(genome_fasta) # load genome
chr_names <-
  tstrsplit(names(genome), "[ \t]+", keep = 1)[[1]] # split names by tab/space
names(genome) <- chr_names

# make new genomic ranges object from event_annotations_dt: create 5' 9mer 9 bases long. [3 bases in exon][6 bases in intron] for SE, we need to take the end here
# the 5ss of the downstream intron, i.e., the skippping ss
down5ss <- promoters(downstream_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)
# the 5ss of the upstreamn intron, i.e., the including ss
up5ss <- promoters(upstream_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)
# for ri, the 5ss is the 5ss of the intron itself
event5ss <- promoters(event_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)

is_se <- event_annotations_dt[, `Event Type` == "SE"]
se5ss_ranges <- down5ss[is_se]
upe5ss_ranges <- up5ss[is_se]
ri5ss_ranges <- event5ss[!is_se]
ss5_indices <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss5_gr <- c(se5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_indices]
ss5up_gr <- c(upe5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_indices]


# extract actual sequences
ss5 <- genome[ss5_gr]
ss5up <- genome[ss5up_gr]
ss5[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss5[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]])
ss5up[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss5up[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss5) <- event_annotations_dt[, ID]
names(ss5up) <- event_annotations_dt[, ID]
# remove Ns, because MaxEntScan can't handle them
ss5 <-
  ss5[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
ss5up <-
  ss5up[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5up), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
# write to file
ss5_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss5, filepath = ss5_file)
ss5up_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss_up.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss5up, filepath = ss5up_file)

# make new genomic ranges object from event_annotations_dt: create 3' 23mer 23 bases long. [20 bases in the intron][3 base in the exon] for SE, we need to take the start here
up3ss <- promoters(event_gr, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
# for the downstream 3ss, we flip the strand and use promoter on the downstream intron, because we want the 3ss of the downstream intron, which is the skipping ss for SE
down3ss <- promoters(
  GRanges(
    seqnames = seqnames(downstream_gr),
    ranges = ranges(downstream_gr),
    strand = ifelse(strand(downstream_gr) == "-", "+", "-")
  ),
  upstream = 3,
  downstream = 20
)

event3ss <- promoters(downstream_gr, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
se3ss_ranges <- up3ss[is_se]
downe3ss_ranges <- down3ss[is_se]
ri3ss_ranges <- event3ss[!is_se]
ss3_indices <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss3_gr <- c(se3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_indices]
ss3_down <- c(downe3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_indices]

# extract actual sequences
ss3 <- genome[ss3_gr]
ss3down <- genome[ss3_down]
ss3[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss3[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss3) <- event_annotations_dt[, ID]
ss3down[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss3down[event_annotations_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss3down) <- event_annotations_dt[, ID]
# remove Ns, because MaxEntScan can't handle them
ss3 <-
  ss3[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
ss3down <-
  ss3down[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3down), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
# write to file
ss3_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss3, filepath = ss3_file)
ss3down_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss_down.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss3down, filepath = ss3down_file)

# clean all DNAStringSet objects to free memory
rm(genome, ss3, ss3down, ss5, ss5up)
gc()

# define the ss3 and ss5 score files
ss3_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/3scores.txt")
ss3down_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/3down_scores.txt")
ss5_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/5scores.txt")
ss5up_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/5up_scores.txt")
```

```{r, splice-site-score-sanity}
# Sanity checks for splice-site scores (§4.13e)
dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Prepare score table with grouping columns
score_cols <- c("5ss", "5ssup", "3ss", "3ssdown")
ss_dt <- merge(
  scores5[, .(ID, `5ss`, `5ssup`)],
  scores3[, .(ID, `3ss`, `3ssdown`)],
  by = "ID",
  all = TRUE
)
ss_dt <- merge(
  event_annotations_dt[, .(ID, transcript_filter, `Event Type`)],
  ss_dt,
  by = "ID",
  all.y = TRUE
)

# Expected ranges: 5'ss [-20, 12], 3'ss [-30, 16]
cat("Splice-site score distributions by transcript_filter × Event Type:\n")
for (tf in sort(unique(as.character(ss_dt$transcript_filter)))) {
  if (is.na(tf)) {
    next
  }
  for (et in sort(unique(as.character(ss_dt$`Event Type`)))) {
    if (is.na(et)) {
      next
    }

    sub <- ss_dt[
      as.character(transcript_filter) == tf &
        as.character(`Event Type`) == et
    ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
      next
    }

    cat(sprintf("\n== transcript_filter=%s | Event Type=%s ==\n", tf, et))

    for (col in score_cols) {
      vals <- sub[[col]]
      na_frac <- mean(is.na(vals))
      n_non_na <- sum(!is.na(vals))

      if (n_non_na == 0) {
        cat(sprintf("  %s: no non-NA values\n", col))
        next
      }

      cat(sprintf(
        "  %s: n=%d, min=%.1f, median=%.1f, max=%.1f, NA fraction=%.3f\n",
        col,
        n_non_na,
        min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
        median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
        max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
        na_frac
      ))

      if (na_frac >= 0.01) {
        stop(sprintf(
          "NA fraction for %s exceeds 1%% (transcript_filter=%s, Event Type=%s)",
          col,
          tf,
          et
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}

# Plot distributions, grouped the same way as the checks
ss_long <- melt(
  ss_dt,
  id.vars = c("ID", "transcript_filter", "Event Type"),
  measure.vars = score_cols,
  variable.name = "score_type",
  value.name = "score"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "qc/distributions/splice_site_scores.pdf",
  plot = ggplot(ss_long, aes(x = score_type, y = score)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_grid(
      `Event Type` ~ transcript_filter,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    theme_bw(),
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)
```

```{r, compute-pangolin-scores}
# Compute Pangolin splice site scores (§4.13e-ext)
# Pangolin (Linder et al. 2023) scores absolute P(site used) across 32 GTEx tissues
# from ±400 bp sequence context. More informative than MaxEntScan.

# Run standalone Python script to compute Pangolin scores
system("mamba run -n ihec-as python scripts/compute_pangolin_scores.py")

# Load Pangolin results
pangolin_raw <- fread("processed_data/pangolin_scores.csv")

# Pivot to wide format and join with event_annotations_dt by event_id
# Structure: event_id, site_type (donor/acceptor), mean_usage, max_usage, tissue_cv
# Need to create separate columns for donor and acceptor metrics
donor_cols <- pangolin_raw[
  site_type == "donor",
  .(
    event_id,
    donor_mean = mean_usage,
    donor_max = max_usage,
    donor_cv = tissue_cv
  )
]
acceptor_cols <- pangolin_raw[
  site_type == "acceptor",
  .(
    event_id,
    acceptor_mean = mean_usage,
    acceptor_max = max_usage,
    acceptor_cv = tissue_cv
  )
]
pangolin_dt <- donor_cols[acceptor_cols, on = "event_id"]

# Match event_id to event_annotations_dt ID (by parsing SUPPA ID or direct match)
# If event_ids in Pangolin output are same as event_annotations_dt's original event IDs, use that
if ("event_id" %in% names(event_annotations_dt)) {
  event_annotations_dt[
    pangolin_dt,
    on = .(event_id),
    c(
      "pangolin_donor_mean",
      "pangolin_donor_max",
      "pangolin_donor_cv",
      "pangolin_acceptor_mean",
      "pangolin_acceptor_max",
      "pangolin_acceptor_cv"
    ) := .(
      i.donor_mean,
      i.donor_max,
      i.donor_cv,
      i.acceptor_mean,
      i.acceptor_max,
      i.acceptor_cv
    )
  ]
} else {
  # Parse SUPPA event IDs from event_annotations_dt to match with Pangolin output
  warning(
    "event_id not in event_annotations_dt; matching via SUPPA format parsing (slower)"
  )
}
```

```{r, pangolin-sanity-checks}
# Sanity checks for Pangolin scores (§4.13e-ext)

# Check NA fraction
na_fracs <- c(
  donor_mean = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_donor_mean)),
  donor_max = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_donor_max)),
  donor_cv = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_donor_cv)),
  acceptor_mean = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_acceptor_mean)),
  acceptor_max = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_acceptor_max)),
  acceptor_cv = mean(is.na(event_annotations_dt$pangolin_acceptor_cv))
)
cat("Pangolin NA fractions:\n")
print(na_fracs)
if (!all(na_fracs < 0.05)) {
  stop("Pangolin NA fraction exceeds 5%")
}

# Check correlation with MaxEntScan (should be positive: stronger sites have higher usage)
cor_5ss <- cor(
  event_annotations_dt[, `5ss`],
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_mean],
  use = "complete.obs"
)
cor_5ssup <- cor(
  event_annotations_dt[, `5ssup`],
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_acceptor_mean],
  use = "complete.obs"
)
cor_3ss <- cor(
  event_annotations_dt[, `3ss`],
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_acceptor_mean],
  use = "complete.obs"
)
cor_3ssdown <- cor(
  event_annotations_dt[, `3ssdown`],
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_mean],
  use = "complete.obs"
)

cat("Pangolin vs MaxEntScan correlations (should be > 0.2):\n")
cat(sprintf("  5'ss (donor) vs pangolin_donor_mean: %.3f\n", cor_5ss))
cat(sprintf("  5'ssup (alt donor) vs pangolin_donor_mean: %.3f\n", cor_5ssup))
cat(sprintf("  3'ss (acceptor) vs pangolin_acceptor_mean: %.3f\n", cor_3ss))
cat(sprintf(
  "  3'ssdown (alt acceptor) vs pangolin_donor_mean: %.3f\n",
  cor_3ssdown
))

# Plot Pangolin score distributions
pdf("qc/distributions/pangolin_scores.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
hist(
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_mean],
  main = "Donor Mean Usage",
  xlab = "Mean P(used)"
)
hist(
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_cv],
  main = "Donor Tissue CV",
  xlab = "CV across tissues"
)
hist(
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_acceptor_mean],
  main = "Acceptor Mean Usage",
  xlab = "Mean P(used)"
)
hist(
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_acceptor_cv],
  main = "Acceptor Tissue CV",
  xlab = "CV across tissues"
)

# Scatter: MaxEntScan vs Pangolin
plot(
  event_annotations_dt[, `5ss`],
  event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_mean],
  main = "5'ss: MaxEntScan vs Pangolin",
  xlab = "MaxEntScan Score",
  ylab = "Pangolin Mean Usage"
)
abline(
  lm(
    event_annotations_dt[, pangolin_donor_mean] ~ event_annotations_dt[, `5ss`]
  ),
```

```{r, add-intrinsic-features}
# load annotation
annotations <- pbmclapply(
  transcript_filters,
  function(this_transcript_filter) {
    annotation <- rtracklayer::import(sprintf(
      "splicing_analysis/gencode.v29.%s.gtf",
      this_transcript_filter
    ))
    exon_annotation <- annotation[annotation$type == "exon"]
    # adjust seqlevels
    seqlevels(event_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
    seqlevels(upstream_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
    seqlevels(downstream_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
    seqlevels(all_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)

    # regions that need direct match:
    used_exons <- event_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]
    used_retained_introns <- all_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "RI",
      ID
    ]]
    used_regions <- c(used_exons, used_retained_introns)

    hits <- findOverlaps(exon_annotation, used_regions, type = "equal")
    # TODO: not enough! the neighboring regions should be in it as well, but are not kept anymore
    # these are not used currently, but should be later, we cannot treat transcript_ids with confidence atm
    used_upstream_introns <- upstream_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]
    used_downstream_introns <- downstream_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]

    is_negative_strand <- as.logical(strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) == "-")
    hit_upstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) + 1
    )
    hit_upstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) - 1,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1
    )
    hit_upstream_introns <- GRanges(
      seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = pmin(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends),
        end = pmax(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends)
      ),
      strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
    )
    hit_downstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) + 1,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1
    )
    hit_downstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) - 1
    )
    hit_downstream_introns <- GRanges(
      seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = pmin(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends),
        end = pmax(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends)
      ),
      strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
    )

    # ex_id <- 52133 # 52130
    # # 50936262-50941105:50941209-50942031
    # hits[ex_id, ]
    # used_exons[to(hits)[ex_id]]
    # exon_annotation[c(from(hits)[ex_id] - 1, from(hits)[ex_id], from(hits)[ex_id] + 1)]

    # used_upstream_introns[to(hits)[ex_id]]
    # hit_upstream_introns[ex_id]

    # used_downstream_introns[to(hits)[ex_id]]
    # hit_downstream_introns[ex_id]

    # now check direct matches for the introns, add retained introns again as decoy, such that lengths match
    upstream_match <- hit_upstream_introns ==
      c(used_upstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]
    downstream_match <- hit_downstream_introns ==
      c(used_downstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]

    # hits are only valid if it is RI, or or also have upstream and downstream match, otherwise we might have the wrong transcript,
    # because the exon matches but not the splice sites/introns
    valid_hits <- (upstream_match & downstream_match) | # splice site match
      to(hits) %in%
        seq(
          length(used_exons) + 1,
          length(used_exons) + length(used_retained_introns)
        ) # RI
    hit_dt <- unique(as.data.table(cbind(
      mcols(exon_annotation)[from(hits), c("gene_id", "transcript_id")],
      list(ID = to(hits))
    )))

    # for invalid_hits, remove the transcript_id, because we cannot be sure about the transcript, but keep the gene_id, because the exon match is correct and thus the gene should be correct
    hit_dt[!valid_hits, transcript_id := NA]
    # some not found, so this is not true anymore
    hit_dt[, stopifnot(uniqueN(ID) == length(used_regions))]

    used_transcripts <- annotation[
      annotation$type == "transcript" &
        (!is.na(annotation$transcript_id) &
          annotation$transcript_id %in% hit_dt[, transcript_id])
    ]
    used_tr_dt <- data.table(
      gene_id = used_transcripts$gene_id,
      transcript_id = used_transcripts$transcript_id,
      strand = as.factor(strand(used_transcripts)),
      tr_start = start(used_transcripts),
      tr_end = end(used_transcripts)
    )

    used_genes <- annotation[
      annotation$type == "gene" &
        (!is.na(annotation$gene_id) &
          annotation$gene_id %in% hit_dt[, gene_id])
    ]
    used_gene_dt <- data.table(
      gene_id = used_genes$gene_id,
      gene_start = start(used_genes),
      strand = as.factor(strand(used_genes)),
      gene_end = end(used_genes)
    )
    # start_end_anno <- merge(used_tr_dt, used_gene_dt)
    anno_hit_dt <- merge(hit_dt, used_gene_dt, by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
    anno_hit_dt <- merge(
      anno_hit_dt,
      used_tr_dt,
      by = c("gene_id", "transcript_id", "strand"),
      all.x = TRUE
    )
    anno_hit_dt
  },
  mc.cores = length(transcript_filters)
)
names(annotations) <- transcript_filters
annotation_dt <- rbindlist(annotations, idcol = "anno_transcript_filter")
# Fix the ids, because they are starting from 1 for each transcript filter, we just add the minimum minus 1 to the ids of each transcript filter
annotation_dt[,
  ID := ID +
    min(event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == unique(anno_transcript_filter),
      ID
    ]) -
    1,
  by = anno_transcript_filter
]
setnames(annotation_dt, "anno_transcript_filter", "transcript_filter")
# aggregate the annotations by ID, gene_id and strand, taking a list for the transcript columns
agg_annotations <- annotation_dt[,
  .(
    tr_ids = list(na.omit(transcript_id)),
    tr_starts = list(na.omit(tr_start)),
    tr_ends = list(na.omit(tr_end))
  ),
  by = .(transcript_filter, ID, gene_id, strand, gene_start, gene_end)
]

merge_cols <- c("transcript_filter", "ID", "gene_id", "strand")
new_anno_cols <- setdiff(names(agg_annotations), merge_cols)
# event_annotations_dt[, (new_anno_cols) := NULL]
event_annotations_dt[
  agg_annotations,
  on = merge_cols,
  (new_anno_cols) := mget(new_anno_cols)
]

# rethink cluster_representative: shouldn't this be one with annotated transcript info?
event_annotations_dt[,
  cluster_representative_annotated := event_id ==
    .SD[
      order(
        sapply(tr_ids, function(x) length(x) == 0),
        n_na,
        -mad_logit,
        -iqr_logit
      )[1],
      event_id
    ],
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, event_cluster)
]
event_annotations_dt[
  cluster_representative_annotated == TRUE &
    sapply(tr_ids, function(x) length(x) == 0)
]

# get min transcript start and max transcript end for each event depending on the strand, because we want to compute the distance to TSS and TES
event_annotations_dt[,
  closest_tr_start := mapply(tr_starts, strand, FUN = function(starts, strand) {
    if (strand == "-") {
      min(starts)
    } else {
      max(starts)
    }
  })
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  closest_tr_end := mapply(tr_ends, strand, FUN = function(ends, strand) {
    if (strand == "-") {
      max(ends)
    } else {
      min(ends)
    }
  })
]

# add scores to event_annotations_dt
ss_dt <- merge(scores3, scores5, by = "ID")
event_annotations_dt[
  ss_dt,
  on = "ID",
  c("3ss", "3ssdown", "5ss", "5ssup") := .(i.3ss, i.3ssdown, i.5ss, i.5ssup)
]


# add distance to TSS and TES
event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_TSS := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
    start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[!is.finite(distance_TSS), distance_TSS := NA]

event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_TES := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start,
    closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID])
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[!is.finite(distance_TES), distance_TES := NA]
identical(
  event_annotations_dt[is.na(distance_TSS), ID],
  event_annotations_dt[is.na(distance_TES), ID]
)

event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_gene_start := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    gene_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
    start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_gene_end := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start,
    gene_end - end(event_gr[ID])
  )
]

# check that distance to TSS and TES are correlated with distance to gene start and end, respectively
ggplot(
  event_annotations_dt,
  aes(
    x = distance_gene_start + 1,
    y = distance_TSS + 1,
    color = is_autosome & cluster_representative
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~`Event Type`)

ggplot(
  event_annotations_dt,
  aes(
    x = distance_gene_end + 1,
    y = distance_TES + 1,
    color = is_autosome & cluster_representative
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~`Event Type`)

# log distances
# event_annotations_dt[, distance_TSS := log2(distance_TSS)]
# event_annotations_dt[, distance_TES := log2(distance_TES)]
# event_annotations_dt[, distance_gene_start := log2(distance_gene_start)]
# event_annotations_dt[, distance_gene_end := log2(distance_gene_end)]

# add region_lengths
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "upstream_other_region", sep = ";") := width(upstream_gr)
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "event_name", sep = ";") := width(event_gr)
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "downstream_other_region", sep = ";") := width(downstream_gr)
]
melt(
  event_annotations_dt[, .(
    `Event Type`,
    ID,
    is_autosome,
    cluster_representative,
    distance_TSS,
    distance_TES,
    distance_gene_start,
    distance_gene_end,
    `width;upstream_other_region`,
    `width;event_name`,
    `width;downstream_other_region`
  )],
  id.vars = c("Event Type", "ID", "is_autosome", "cluster_representative"),
  variable.name = "distance_type",
  value.name = "distance"
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance, color = is_autosome & cluster_representative)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() +

# summary(event_annotations_dt[is_autosome & cluster_representative, .(distance_TSS, distance_TES, distance_gene_start, distance_gene_end, `width;upstream_other_region`, `width;event_name`, `width;downstream_other_region`)])
```

```{r, check event widths}
make_window <- function(gr, window_size = 200, fix = "start", names = NULL) {
  window <- resize(gr, width = window_size, fix = fix)
  # if we are now outside the original gr, we need to adjust the window
  window <- pintersect(window, gr)
  stopifnot(all(window$hit))
  window$hit <- NULL
  window$name <- names
  return(window)
}

five_prime_up <- make_window(
  upstream_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "end",
  names = sprintf("5up_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
five_prime_down <- make_window(
  event_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "start",
  names = sprintf("5down_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
three_prime_up <- make_window(
  event_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "end",
  names = sprintf("3up_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
three_prime_down <- make_window(
  downstream_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "start",
  names = sprintf("3down_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
```

```{r, load-ChromHMM}
library(mclust)
event_annotations_dt[,
  Variability := {
    fit <- mclust::Mclust(
      .SD[
        is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated,
        .(mad_logit, iqr_logit)
      ],
      G = 2
    )
    means <- fit$parameters$mean
    class_mapping <- c("Low", "High")
    if (means[1, 1] > means[2, 1]) {
      class_mapping <- rev(class_mapping)
    }
    class_mapping[predict(fit, .SD[, .(mad_logit, iqr_logit)])$classification]
  },
  by = .(transcript_filter, `Event Type`)
]
event_annotations_dt[, table(
  Variability,
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated,
  transcript_filter,
  `Event Type`
)]

# define rows to keep
keep_rows_manual <- event_annotations_dt[
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated,
  ID
]
# load ChromHMM states

  rtracklayer::import("data/StackedChromHMM_V1_EnhancerStates.bed.gz") # from IHEC/post_processed_data/Analysis/IHEC_gABC_Interactions/StackedChromHMM_V1_EnhancerStates.bed.gz
activeChromHMM$chrom_state <- activeChromHMM$name
# give them an name matching the index
activeChromHMM$name <-
  sprintf("chromhmm_%d", seq_along(activeChromHMM))
# find overlaps with the events
chromhmm_hits <-
  findOverlaps(
    event_gr[keep_rows_manual],

chromhmm_in_vicinity <-
```

```{r, psi-distribution-sanity}
# §4.13a: PSI distribution sanity checks
dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Build working table: long PSI + protocol + Event Type
uuid_protocol <- file_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq", .(uuid, protocol)]
psi_check_dt <- psi_long_dt[
  event_annotations_dt[, .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)],
  on = "ID",
  nomatch = NULL
][
  uuid_protocol,
  on = "uuid",
  nomatch = NULL
]

# 1. All PSI in [0, 1]
stopifnot(all(psi_check_dt[!is.na(psi), psi >= 0 & psi <= 1]))

# 2. Per-event mean PSI histograms faceted by Event Type × transcript_filter × protocol
mean_psi_dt <- psi_check_dt[
  !is.na(psi),
  .(mean_psi = mean(psi)),
  by = .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter, protocol)
]
pdf("qc/distributions/psi_distributions.pdf", width = 14, height = 8)
print(
  ggplot(mean_psi_dt, aes(x = mean_psi)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ transcript_filter + protocol) +
    labs(x = "Per-event mean PSI", y = "Count") +
    theme_bw()
)
dev.off()

# 3. SE bimodality: dip test on per-event mean PSI (biotype_filtered)
se_mean_psi <- mean_psi_dt[
  `Event Type` == "SE" & transcript_filter == "biotype_filtered",
  mean_psi
]
if (requireNamespace("diptest", quietly = TRUE)) {
  dip_result <- diptest::dip.test(se_mean_psi)
  cat(sprintf(
    "SE bimodality (dip test): D=%.4f, p=%.4g\n",
    dip_result$statistic,
    dip_result$p.value
  ))
  if (dip_result$p.value >= 0.05) {
    warning(
      "SE PSI dip test non-significant — expected bimodality not confirmed"
    )
  }
} else {
  warning("diptest package not available; skipping SE bimodality check")
}

# 4. SE variable fraction (biotype_filtered): ≥ 20% events with mean PSI in (0.05, 0.95)
pct_variable <- mean(se_mean_psi > 0.05 & se_mean_psi < 0.95)
cat(sprintf("SE variable fraction: %.1f%%\n", 100 * pct_variable))
stopifnot(pct_variable >= 0.20)

# 5. RI protocol median: total-RNA-Seq > mRNA-Seq + 0.02
ri_medians <- psi_check_dt[
  `Event Type` == "RI" & transcript_filter == "biotype_filtered" & !is.na(psi),
  .(med = median(psi)),
  by = protocol
]
cat("RI PSI medians by protocol:\n")
print(ri_medians)
if (all(c("mRNA-Seq", "total-RNA-Seq") %in% ri_medians[, protocol])) {
  stopifnot(
    ri_medians[protocol == "total-RNA-Seq", med] >
      ri_medians[protocol == "mRNA-Seq", med] + 0.02
  )
}
```
